in_hebrew.name: קאם
in_hebrew.meaning: מקור השם קאם לא ידוע בדיוק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קאם אינו מופיע ישירות בתנ"ך העברי. עם זאת, הוא עשוי להיות קשור למילה העברית 'קום' שפירושה 'לקום' או 'להתעורר'. שם זה עשוי להיות בעל משמעות רוחנית הקשורה להתעוררות או למקור חדש.

in_greek.name: Καμ
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Καμ δεν έχει συγκεκριμένη σημασία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καμ δεν αναφέρεται ρητά στις σελίδες της Καινής Διαθήκης. Ενδέχεται όμως να συνδέεται με ελληνικές λέξεις που σημαίνουν 'κάμψη' ή 'καμπύλη'. Στην πνευματική του διάσταση, το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει την ταπείνωση ή την ευελιότητα.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Cam' has been used as a given name in various cultures and languages. In English and Scottish origin, it is believed to be derived from the Hebrew name 'Kam', meaning 'helper'. This name embodies the values of assistance, courage, and dedication. Cam mentioned in the Bible (Genesis 30:33) as the name of one of Jacob's sons, who was affectionately called "Camel", interestingly meaning 'domicile' or 'tent'. This name has been popularized in the English-speaking world through famous figures such as Cam Winston, Cam Newton, and Camila Cabello, inspiring generations with their accomplishments.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Cam' holds spiritual significance for Christians mainly because of its biblical origins. In Genesis 30:32, the name 'Camel' is given to one of Jacob's sons as a reward for his dedicated service to his father. This name denotes a bond or covenant between Jacob and his son, emphasizing the importance of unconditional love and loyalty. In the spiritual sense, the name 'Cam' motivates us to remain steadfast in our faith and responsibilities throughout our lives, providing the courage and strength to help those around us while growing spiritually ourselves.
